name: zenodo-mcp-server
description: Search and resolve Zenodo datasets, software, and publications by DOI; trace versions and funding, list files, and preview text files via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

zenodo_access_token.title: Zenodo access token
zenodo_access_token.description: Optional Zenodo personal access token, created with no scopes. Raises Zenodo's rate limit from 60 to 100 requests per minute; searches stay at 25 per minute. Generate one at zenodo.org/account/settings/applications/tokens/new.
